title: GPT3Bot
tagline: Can we create a bot that automatic response all our questions about IPFS using AI?  yes, just look @ OpenAIBot
description: OpenAIBot uses GPT3  AI model . This example shows the intersection of DiscordBot API and OpenAI API . You can ask the bot whatever open question and it returns the answer.  Q&A about IPFS ,  web3 concepts  of whatever question you like .. it also can generate code, for example IPFS js or python or even create an ERC-20 or ERC-721 in Solidity
how_its_made: Its implemented using Discord JS and OpenAI API (that uses GPT-3 models of AI state-of-the-art in Artificial Intelligence). With this bot you can also generate code, for example IPFS javascript code or python or even create an ERC-20 or ERC-721 contract in Solidity.  Artificial Intelligence is a process of programming a computers and Open API specifically, is an AI model that have many advantages over traditional artificial intelligence techniques.
